svg.aria-label: Before a task OpenReflex retrieves experience, scores paths and injects context; during a task it watches tool calls, flags loops and recommends continue, pivot or stop; after a task it infers the outcome, estimates regret and extracts lessons, which feed the Experience Graph for the next task.
